verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਨੀ ਬਾਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਟੂਟਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਚੁੰਬਿਕ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise anee baan rahit TooT dhehee bikhai chu(n)bik dhikhaae tatakaal nikasat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the tip of an arrow breaks inside the wound on the body and it is pulled out with the help of a magnet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੋਕ ਤੋਂਬਰੀ ਲਗਾਈਅਤ ਰੋਗੀ ਤਨ ਐਂਚ ਲੇਤ ਰੁਧਿਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਖਸਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jok to(n)baree lagaieeat rogee tan aai(n)ch let rudhir birathaa sram khasat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a leech is put on the boil of a patient that sucks out all the dirty blood and pus thus relieving the patient of the pain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੁਵਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਕਰੈ ਦਾਈ ਗਰਭ ਸਥੰਭਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੀੜਾ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise juvatin prat maradhan karai dhaiee garabh satha(n)bhan hui peeRaa na grasat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a midwife massages the stomach of a pregnant lady to relieve her of pain and discomfort.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਬਿਭ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਭਾਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise paa(n)cho dhoot bhoot bibhram hui bhaag jaat satigur ma(n)t ja(n)t rasanaa rasat hai ||365||

en.bdb: Similarly, he who has been blessed with the divine word by the True Guru to meditate on and he practices it ardently enjoying the elixir-like Naam with his tongue, is able to dispel the influence of the five demons i.e., lust, anger, attachment, greed and ego. (365)
